**First Horizon (FHN) 3Q26: Slight Core Miss vs. 2Q26 Masked by $4.5B Mortgage Sale Restructuring**

**Headline & EPS Drivers:** Focusing on **adjusted** diluted EPS, FHN posted $0.53 in 3Q26, missing 2Q26 ($0.54) by $0.01 (-2% QoQ) but up $0.02 YoY [B0148]. Reported GAAP EPS was a loss of $(0.20) vs. $0.54 in 2Q26 [B0109], depressed by $(0.73) per share ($347 million after-tax) in net notable items—primarily a $473 million pre-tax loss on reclassifying ~$4.5 billion of lower-yielding consumer mortgages to held-for-sale, partially offset by a $45 million reserve reversal, alongside $5 million in Visa derivative expenses and $3 million in restructuring charges [B0007, B0782]. On an underlying basis, adjusted PPNR edged down $2 million (-1% QoQ) to $362 million, while adjusted provision rose $5 million to $20 million and the adjusted tax rate normalized up 149 bps to 21.0% [B0144, B0145, B0776].

**Revenue & Margin:** GAAP NII rose $7 million (+1% QoQ) to $683 million ($686 million FTE) on a 6 bps expansion in loan yields to 5.73% and day count [B0071, B0073, B0036, B0786]. FTE NIM compressed 1 bp QoQ to 3.48% as interest-bearing deposit costs rose 12 bps to 2.45% from brokered deposit carryover and higher client rates [B0200, B0036, B0786]. Reported noninterest income was $(276) million due to the $473 million mortgage mark [B0084, B0081]; adjusted noninterest income fell $14 million QoQ to $197 million on lower deferred compensation (-$17 million), though fees ex-deferred comp rose $3 million to $198 million led by fixed income (+$3 million, ADR $629k) [B0131, B0792]. Reported expenses fell $2 million to $529 million [B0096], while adjusted expenses ex-deferred comp rose $8 million to $521 million on seasonal new-account promotions [B0794]; adjusted efficiency improved 20 bps to 58.91% (reported 129.56%) [B0208, B0209].

**Credit:** Credit remained benign. Reported provision was a $(25) million benefit ($20 million adjusted) [B0098, B0145]. NCOs ticked up to $36 million (0.22% vs. 0.20% in 2Q26) [B0443, B0449], while NPLs fell $49 million to $482 million (0.81% flat QoQ) and ACL coverage edged up 1 bp to 1.25% [B0397, B0404, B0211].

**Capital & Returns:** Reported ROTCE was (5.33)% and adjusted ROTCE dipped 93 bps QoQ to 14.36% [B0204, B0205]. CET1 fell 12 bps to 10.3% and TBVPS dropped $0.69 to $13.84 on the mortgage restructuring [B0213, B0223, B0798]. Buybacks paused to $4 million [B0798].

**Guidance & Thesis:** Management guided FY26 adjusted revenue growth to the low end of 3%–7% and trimmed the CET1 target to 10.25%–10.5% (from ~10.5%), while projecting +4% (+$45 million) 2027 earnings accretion and ~150 bps ROTCE lift from the mortgage sale [B0800, B0784]. The balance sheet repositioning modestly improves the medium-term thesis by trading near-term TBV dilution for structurally higher ROTCE and a healthier 88.3% LDR [B0225].
